rounds.topic: Naive Point-to-Point vs Multi-Target Matrix Expansion — Deep Investigation Loop 1
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 1: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of naive point-to-point vs multi-target matrix expansion. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.
